dataset.name: nlile/24-game
dataset.sampling: upstream linspace index rule; fixed task rows committed before model generation

model.backend: repository CUDA adapter; Transformers 4.55.2 / PyTorch 2.9.1 CUDA 12.8
model.note: Model differs from the upstream 30B-A3B-Thinking checkpoint; this is an adaptation.

generation.seed_rule: 42 + dataset row index; paired policies share the same initial seed; post-trigger continuation uses initial seed + 1000003

terminal_evaluator: independent exact AST/Fraction evaluator; only +, -, *, /; use every input integer once
purpose: Published-baseline execution and outcome/cost qualification on a fixed public development sample; not a confirmatory or Jev efficacy study.
